Versatile Silicone Lubricant Stops Customer Complaints ... Fast!
Print advertisement for Dow Corning 4X lubricant manufactured and sold by the Dow Corning Corporation for use lubricating, preserving, and insulating rubber parts and electrical systems. The advertisement features images of the lubricant in both spray can and tube packaging, as well as depictions of the application of lubricant to car and electrical parts. This advertisement appeared on page 163 of the May 1966 edition of Motor magazine.
